test_title: PYST 22: SSC GD Constable 2022 - English (Held On : 17 Jan 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Directin: Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution’.**

She was embarrassed because **__her friends were laughing on her__. **

options.text: her friends were laughing upon her
her friends were laughing at her
her friends were laughing to her

solution:
The correct answer is **"her friends were laughing at her."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error lies in the part **"laughing on"** of the sentence.
 
• The sentence **"She was embarrassed because her friends were laughing on her" **contains a preposition error.
 
• Instead of** "laughing on,"** it should be** "laughing at."**
 
• So, the correct answer is Option 2.**
 ​

Correct sentence: ***She was embarrassed because **her friends were laughing at her**__.*
